title: Windows 11 virtual-camera transport architecture selection
hardware: Windows 11 Pro build 26300; 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13700H; Intel Iris Xe Graphics; driver 32.0.101.7092
dependencies: FFmpeg 9.0.2 full build (probe fixture generation only)

gates.correctness: 1000 delivered frames, strict sequence accounting, zero torn or malformed frames
gates.applications: OBS, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Discord, DingTalk, and Tencent Meeting separately
gates.recovery: producer restart, 30-second stall, client reopen, sleep/resume, and privacy recovery
gates.soak: 10 minutes each in OBS and Tencent Meeting
gates.reduced_mode_characterization: M2 source-owned; 1000 frames per mode; target fps minus 0.5 minimum; one target-frame interval maximum p95; zero sequence or marker errors; zero pre-Frame-Server full-frame CPU copies
gates.request_credit_characterization: M2 source-owned request-credit pacing; 1000 target frames per mode; every request published or explicitly cancelled; every published buffer released; mode-specific throughput and p95 gates; zero sequence, marker, slot-pressure, or pre-Frame-Server copy errors
gates.source_local_render: S1 allocator-owned GPU rendering in the media-source process; 1000 NV12 1920x1080 frames at 29.5-31.0fps; render-to-client p95 no more than 33.3ms; zero sequence or marker errors; zero pre-Frame-Server full-frame CPU copies
gates.source_local_productization: H9 protocol v2 interactive-user control; restricted and low-integrity write denial; asset and protocol validation; fail-safe producer-dead transition; producer and Frame Server recovery; side-by-side activation; registration and artifact cleanup
gates.source_local_physical_camera: H8A exact physical-camera symbolic link; standalone, capture-only, copy-only, and full 1,000-frame RCA; allocator-adapter GPU capture; at least 29.5fps; capture-to-client p95 no more than 33.3ms; zero sequence, marker, physical-content, or pre-Frame-Server CPU copy errors; registration and staged artifacts restored in finally

verdict.scope: No tested Wave-1 app-to-source transport passed the unchanged NV12 1920x1080 30fps gates. S1 deterministic source-local rendering passed the automated gate, H9 protocol-v2 productization, and the available recovery, OBS, and Tencent Meeting subset. Corrected H8A evidence proves stable 1,000-frame physical capture and GPU conversion, but the integrated path reached only 29.327fps and 50.167ms p95, failing both strict gates. The source-adapter handoff also failed its latency gate. M2 source-owned NV12 1920x1080 at 15fps remains a separate unaccepted product-fallback candidate. No transport primary or technical fallback is selected.
